程序包 io.papermc.paper.event.world

类 WorldDifficultyChangeEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.world.WorldEvent
io.papermc.paper.event.world.WorldDifficultyChangeEvent
@NullMarked public class WorldDifficultyChangeEvent extends WorldEvent
当世界难度被命令或 API 更改时调用。

如果世界处于 hardcore，最终难度将始终为 Difficulty.HARD
